name: TC-PTB-05: clicking each popular brand card navigates to that brand page
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/PopularTruckBrands.cy.js#Homepage - PopularTruckBrands [ta] TC-PTB-05: clicking each popular brand card navigates to that brand page
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PTB-05
**Title:** Clicking each popular brand card navigates to that brand page
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
From the Popular Truck Brands section, click each brand card shown on this device and confirm the user is taken to the correct brand listing page for that brand and language. Mobile only shows the first 6 brands, so only those 6 are clicked.

**Expected Result:**
After each shown brand card click, the browser URL path is /{language}/{brand-slug} for that brand (real navigation to the brand page).

**Steps:**
1. Open the Popular Truck Brands section
2. Click each brand card in turn
3. Verify navigation to the matching brand page URL
4. Return to the homepage and continue with the next brand
